purpose: Discovery inventory of community bibliographies, art-location maps and general BTS archives that can generate research leads for The Namjoon Index.
editorialRule: An archive entry is a lead, never verification. Publish only after the underlying RM, BIGHIT/HYBE, broadcaster, publisher, artist, gallery, museum or catalogue source has been checked at a reproducible locator.

priorityDefinitions.P0: Extract first: specialised, structured and likely to yield many distinct leads.
priorityDefinitions.P1: Use for cross-checking, recovery of primary URLs or targeted extraction.
priorityDefinitions.P2: Use selectively when stronger archives are silent or inaccessible.

archives.title: Namjoon's Booklist
archives.coverageSignal: The site describes itself as a living catalogue of books RM recommended, carried or was seen reading; the exact item count was not exposed to the text crawler.
archives.sourceLinkage: Claims every entry is traced to the interview, broadcast or post where the book surfaced.
strengths: Specialised RM-only scope
Separates several modes of appearance in its own description
Promises item-level source links
risks: The catalogue is client-rendered and needs browser-assisted extraction
The archive's relationship labels must not be inherited without checking the cited source
archives.nextAction: Open the rendered catalogue, export every title, author, archive label and cited primary URL, then deduplicate against existing entities.

archives.title: Namjoon's Library
archives.coverageSignal: An actively curated list with a separate external spreadsheet; a preserved social mirror refers to the project's 100th covered book.
archives.sourceLinkage: Book cards describe Namjoon's connection and often route to a post or supporting resource.
strengths: Specialised RM scope
Active curation
Useful educational context and title variants
Separate sheet is suitable for systematic intake
risks: The public page mixes evidentiary links with contextual reading resources
Some item detail lives on X and may be fragile or inaccessible
archives.nextAction: Extract the external sheet, preserving each item's exact connection language and its outbound source separately from contextual resources.

archives.title: ARTWITHRM
archives.coverageSignal: The locations page exposed more than 50 museums, galleries, fairs and art spaces across Asia, Europe and North America in the first loaded page.
archives.sourceLinkage: The project says locations derive from RM's Instagram posts, media interviews or official schedules.
strengths: Dedicated RM art-journey scope
Geographic structure
Location-level pages can seed museums, exhibitions and artworks
Community submission route may surface new leads
risks: A listed location does not by itself establish the visit date, exhibition or viewed artwork
Some pages may rely on deleted Instagram posts or media summaries
The map and some post pages are intermittently difficult to fetch
archives.nextAction: Extract all location pages and record the page's stated origin; verify visit, exhibition and artwork as three separate possible claims.

archives.title: Vancouver Public Library — Namjoon's Bookshelf
archives.coverageSignal: 83 catalogue items at review time, including literature, art books and exhibition catalogues.
archives.sourceLinkage: Many entries include a short provenance note such as an Instagram date, broadcast or bookshelf image.
strengths: Structured bibliographic records
Often supplies dates and concise scene descriptions
Strong source for edition and creator normalisation
risks: The list mixes recommendations, visible possessions and books said to have influenced BTS
Short notes usually lack a direct primary URL
At least one platform attribution in the existing project research was inaccurate
archives.nextAction: Extract all 83 records and split the VPL description into the narrowest candidate relation before searching for the dated primary post or video.

archives.title: read with bts rkive
archives.coverageSignal: The compiler describes a 73-book working list and names the upstream archives used.
archives.sourceLinkage: Many remarks contain a date, programme name, scene description or link.
strengths: Rich scene-level notes
Useful map of older fan bibliographies
Good recovery source for broadcasts and bookshelf-identification leads
risks: Mixes RM, other members, group concepts, props and fan theories
Reading status in the table can describe the compiler rather than RM
Some links point to comments or other community identifications
archives.nextAction: Extract only RM-attributed rows and preserve the compiler's category and remarks verbatim in lead notes; reject theory-only rows from factual intake.

archives.title: BTS Library / Namjoon's reading list
archives.coverageSignal: The page describes 132 Namjoon posts and presents a large alphabetical title list; last stated update is 2021-07-06.
archives.sourceLinkage: The list mainly provides title and creator; it rarely gives the original RM locator on the page.
strengths: Large early inventory
Useful Korean and English title variants
Strong coverage of art books and catalogues
risks: Conflates books owned and recommended
Stale after mid-2021
Some outbound PDF/EPUB links may be unauthorised and must not be copied, downloaded or cited
archives.nextAction: Use only as a title-discovery list. Ignore downloadable book files and locate independent public evidence for every proposed RM relationship.

archives.title: BTS Bangtan Archive
archives.coverageSignal: A year-by-year archive from pre-debut through 2026 with separate social-media and content pages.
archives.sourceLinkage: Entries commonly link official Instagram, X, YouTube, Weverse or institutional posts and preserve dates.
strengths: Strong chronology
Useful recovery path for official links and now-deleted social posts
Broad coverage of RM official activity
risks: Not specialised by cultural object
Archived screenshots are context, not a substitute for an available primary source
Search and navigation are manual
archives.nextAction: Use dates and official outbound links to resolve leads generated by specialised book and art archives.

archives.title: BTS Content Index
archives.coverageSignal: A chronological index of English-subtitled BTS video content from pre-debut onward, with separate paid-content listings.
archives.sourceLinkage: Designed to locate programmes, episodes and official or licensed video surfaces rather than identify cultural objects.
strengths: Best candidate for resolving programme titles and dates
Useful bridge from a fan identification to an official episode or clip
Explicitly says it does not itself host paid content
risks: Not an object bibliography
Availability and legality of third-party subtitled links must be checked individually
A content listing does not verify what appears at a given timestamp
archives.nextAction: Use after a lead names a programme; record the official programme URL and lawful access route, then inspect the exact timestamp separately.

archives.title: US BTS ARMY — BTS in the U.S.
archives.coverageSignal: State and city guides include RM's museum and gallery stops; the Texas page preserves source links and screenshots for deleted Instagram posts.
archives.sourceLinkage: Location entries commonly include an official site and a labelled reference link.
strengths: Geographically structured
Explicit references
Can preserve visual context after RM archives a post
risks: Mixed BTS scope
Location pages also include restaurants, venues and photo spots outside this project's cultural scope
Deleted-post screenshots need independent corroboration where the public claim is consequential
archives.nextAction: Extract only museum, gallery, foundation and art-site records attributable to RM; use the listed institution and date to find institutional corroboration.

archives.title: artansonyeondan
archives.coverageSignal: Community recommendations describe it as a long-running account that identifies artworks, art parallels and RM museum visits.
archives.sourceLinkage: Individual posts may contain artwork and venue identifications, but the account could not be audited systematically through the text search surface.
strengths: Specialist art knowledge
Likely source of difficult artwork identifications
Useful historical coverage
risks: Social-only archive with unstable access
Search results can disappear or lose thread context
Some posts may be thematic comparison rather than documented RM connection
archives.nextAction: Audit with an authenticated browser by date and keyword; save only post URLs and concise identification notes, never treat parallels as RM influence.

archives.title: r/bangtan contemporaneous post archive
archives.coverageSignal: Dated submission threads and weekly round-ups frequently preserve the original official outbound URL and contemporary viewer observations.
archives.sourceLinkage: Usually strongest as a URL resolver or contemporaneous corroborating record, not as standalone authority.
strengths: Precise dates
Often preserves legacy Weverse, X, Instagram and YouTube URLs
Episode discussion threads can narrow a scene to a specific release
risks: Not a controlled catalogue
Comments mix observation, memory, jokes and speculation
Search is noisy and post titles may omit the cultural object
archives.nextAction: Search by date, title and event after specialised archives generate a lead; cite the recovered official URL as primary whenever accessible.

archives.title: Tertulia mirror of Namjoon's Library
archives.coverageSignal: 36 mirrored book records at review time, carrying text from Namjoon's Library posts and some original X links.
archives.sourceLinkage: Preserves parts of social captions and links, sometimes including the specific RM post or scene description.
strengths: Recovery layer when X is inaccessible
Structured book metadata
Can expose source wording omitted from the Carrd overview
risks: Incomplete subset
Commercial book metadata may not match the edition visible in RM's source
Mirrored text is one step further from the primary material
archives.nextAction: Use only to recover a JooniesLibrary post or primary URL that cannot be reached through the main archive.

archives.title: Borasaek Vision — A Very Artsy Tour: RM's Voyage through the US
archives.coverageSignal: A 2022 roundup of RM's December 2021 U.S. museum and gallery route, covering institutions and selected artworks.
archives.sourceLinkage: Captions often attribute images to @rkive and link institution pages for works or exhibitions.
strengths: Coherent itinerary
Names venues, exhibitions and example works
Useful cross-check for the U.S. art-trip cluster
risks: Single-period coverage
Some institution descriptions are general context rather than evidence of RM's encounter
Image captions do not always link the exact original RM post
archives.nextAction: Use to compare U.S. trip coverage against ARTWITHRM and US BTS ARMY; verify every venue and artwork separately.

archives.title: 0613 Archive
archives.coverageSignal: A general BTS media archive with organised BangtanTV, Weverse and discography sections; it says 2021–2022 is fully updated.
archives.sourceLinkage: Useful for locating public content, not for supplying object-level claims.
strengths: Coverage of the Instagram-launch and In the SOOP period
Organised by platform and year
Potential recovery route for missing video context
risks: Not RM- or culture-specific
Coverage outside 2021–2022 may be incomplete
Archived media must be checked for lawful public availability before use
archives.nextAction: Use only when a dated lead cannot be resolved through BTS Content Index or an official platform.
